description: Gopalganj Science and Technology University measured electricity at its campus substation in Bangladesh. The repository describes hourly system voltage, three-phase currents and power factor, with a joined weather version containing temperature, humidity, precipitation, wind speed and solar radiation. Its stated span is 1 August 2023 to 30 September 2025, including academic and vacation periods. Current Mendeley version 3 lists four CSV files, four Excel workbooks and a readme, freely accessible under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is one campus substation, not national electricity demand or all buildings separately. Electrical power or energy interpretation requires checking the workbook columns and meter definitions; no values or missing-hour pattern were inspected. A reviewer-assessed simulation use is fitting campus demand profiles and weather sensitivities for capacity planning. model-pypsa is a related electricity-system planning environment, but no conversion of these measurements into its hourly input structure was tested. No data files or article PDF were downloaded.
